sentences.text: `` Diamonds '' is a song recorded by Barbadian singer Rihanna for her seventh studio album , Unapologetic -LRB- 2012 -RRB- .	Rihanna	Rihanna	Unapologetic	Unapologetic	Barbadian	Barbadians	Diamonds	Diamonds World Tour
It was written by Sia Furler together with its producers , Benny Blanco and StarGate .	Sia Furler	Sia Furler	Benny Blanco	Benny Blanco	StarGate	Stargate (production team)

The song premiered on September 26 , 2012 , during the Elvis Duran and the Morning Show and was digitally released the following day as the lead single from Unapologetic .	Unapologetic	Unapologetic	Elvis Duran and the Morning Show	Elvis Duran and the Morning Show	digitally	music download	lead single	lead single

Def Jam Recordings serviced the single to contemporary hit radio in the United States on October 2 .	Def Jam	Def Jam Recordings	Def Jam Recordings	Def Jam Recordings	contemporary hit radio	contemporary hit radio

`` Diamonds '' is a mid-tempo pop , electronic and R&B ballad that features heavy synthesizers , orchestral sounds and electronic rhythms .	pop	Pop music	R&B	Contemporary R&B	electronic	Electronic music	ballad	ballad	Diamonds	Diamonds World Tour
The song 's lyrics serve as a departure from the themes of unhealthy relationships that were on Rihanna 's previous singles and contain a prominent concept of love .	Rihanna	Rihanna

`` Diamonds '' topped music charts in over twenty countries , including the United States , where it became Rihanna 's twelfth number one single on the Billboard Hot 100 and tied her with Madonna and The Supremes for the fifth-most number one singles in the chart 's history . By May 2013 , it had sold over 7.5 million copies worldwide and became one of the best-selling singles of all-time .	one of the best-selling singles of all-time	List of best-selling singles

The song 's music video was shot by director Anthony Mandler , a frequent collaborator of Rihanna 's , and depicts her in four environments that represent the elements of earth , air , water , and fire .	Rihanna	Rihanna	music video	music video	Anthony Mandler	Anthony Mandler
The video received positive reviews and was praised for its imagery .
Some critics believe that the heavily tattooed man intertwined with Rihanna 's arm in the video resembles Chris Brown .	Rihanna	Rihanna	Chris Brown	Chris Brown
